release_notes:
Vortex PT v1.0.8:
• Exact Net Floor Slab Area: Geometric union calculation for ADAPT and RAM Concept accurately eliminates double-counting of sunken slabs, up-panels, and drop panels (e.g. 1443.31 m² matching ADAPT report).
• ADAPT-Builder Soffit Chair Heights: End anchor chair heights in schedules, tables, and cross-section profiles are strictly measured from bottom soffit (100mm on 300mm slab with 200mm top cover), with top-cover asterisk annotations reserved for CAD drawing plan.
• Collinear Aligned Interior Tendon Spacing Dimensions: 2-3 clean, aligned straight dimension lines perpendicular across tendons with zero collision with chair callouts, ray-cast extensions touching slab edges, and support for short tendons.
